description:
Cast Essence Flux by paying {U}, targeting Archaeomancer.
Tura Kennerüd triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Resolve Essence Flux, blinking Archaeomancer.
Archaeomancer enters the battlefield, returning Essence Flux from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Soldier, adding {U}.
Repeat.
